title: Revitalift dashboard reference
text: Output file: js/dashboard-data.js. Taxonomy charts 4-5: js/dashboard-taxonomy-de.js. Classify each PULSAR comment with mood, segment, topics[]. Chart 4: procedure + procedureTone for segments procedure-open and procedure-curious. Chart 5: ingredient + ingredientTone for segment skincare-first. Chart 6: Appinio survey percents only, not from comments.

title: Mood Map
text: Chart 1: Mood Map. Source: PULSAR comments. Structure: fixed. Every comment gets exactly one mood id.. Output: moodMap.moods[].count
name: Mood Map
rule: Every comment gets exactly one mood id.

title: Topic Landscape
text: Chart 2: Topic Landscape. Source: PULSAR comments. Structure: semi-fixed. Count mentions per candidate topic. positive + negative <= count. UI shows top topN by count.. Output: topicLandscape.candidates[]. Fill fields: count, positive, negative. Comment field: topics[] (array of topic ids)
name: Topic Landscape
rule: Count mentions per candidate topic. positive + negative <= count. UI shows top topN by count.

title: Consumer Segmentation
text: Chart 3: Consumer Segmentation. Source: PULSAR comments. Structure: fixed. Every comment gets exactly one segment id.. Output: segmentation.segments[].count
name: Consumer Segmentation
rule: Every comment gets exactly one segment id.

title: Procedures, Effects & Scares
text: Chart 4: Procedures, Effects & Scares. Source: PULSAR comments. Structure: taxonomy fixed, aggregates dynamic. Audience: procedure-open, procedure-curious. Output: procedureEffects.aggregates.procedures[]. Level 1: procedure (id from chart4.level1). Level 2: procedureTone (id from chart4.level2a or level2b)
name: Procedures, Effects & Scares

title: Ingredients, Concerns & Results
text: Chart 5: Ingredients, Concerns & Results. Source: PULSAR comments. Structure: taxonomy fixed, aggregates dynamic. Audience: skincare-first. Output: skincareIngredients.aggregates.procedures[]. Level 1: ingredient (id from chart5.level1). Level 2: ingredientTone (id from chart5.level2a concern or level2b result)
name: Ingredients, Concerns & Results
level2_field: ingredientTone (id from chart5.level2a concern or level2b result)

title: Decision Drivers
text: Chart 6: Decision Drivers. Source: Appinio survey n=450. Structure: fixed. Do NOT recompute from comments. Use fixed survey percent values.. Output: decisionDrivers.drivers[].percent
name: Decision Drivers
rule: Do NOT recompute from comments. Use fixed survey percent values.

title: Comment object schema
text: id: unique number or string; text: verbatim quote; mood: one of chart1.moods[].id; segment: one of chart3.segments[].id; topics: array of chart2.candidates[].id; procedure: chart4 level1 item id (if procedure-related); procedureTone: chart4 level2a/2b item id; ingredient: chart5 level1 item id (if skincare-related); ingredientTone: chart5 level2a/2b item id
